testcase.system-out: Scenario: Resize the docked model browser ✔ Given a part document is open in the MCAD Software ✔ And the model browser is docked to the left of the viewport ✔ When the user drags the boundary between the model browser and viewport to the right ✔ Then the model browser becomes wider ✔ And the viewport becomes narrower ✔ And the document and model tree remain displayed ✔ When the user drags the boundary back to its original position ✔ Then the model browser and viewport return to their previous widths
